title: Ali Bayat Realty lead (contact form submission)
description: Sent as multipart/form-data by POST to CONFIG.form_endpoint. Fields arrive as strings. The endpoint owns received_at, deduplication, storage and forwarding.

consent.description: Visitor agreed to the consent wording identified by consent_version

source_page.description: Same-site path the visitor came from (e.g. /invest/); empty if direct or JS off

source_cta.description: page-key:cta-id of the link that led to the form

timestamp.description: Client ISO-8601 time at submit; informational only. Empty without JS.

referrer.description: Origin only (scheme + host) of an external referring site, e.g. https://www.google.com

website.description: Honeypot. Must be empty; discard the submission otherwise.
